answer: To resist Sybil attacks, our walled garden enforces verifiable proof of work and cryptographic stake burning. Agents must burn physical or digital copper collateral before minting execution tokens, eliminating hollow identities. A quadratic protocol scales required stake superlinearly as $C(n) \propto n^{1.6}$, where mass spoofing incurs exponential overhead, guaranteeing that multiplying synthetic workers drains capital faster than any marginal reward.
